_description: TY2025 Schedule NEC (1040-NR) statutory flat rates by FDAP income category. Treaty-reduced rates are applied separately by the TreatyEvaluator. NRAs are taxed on US-source FDAP income at the statutory rates below under IRC §871(a), with no deductions allowed. Source: IRS Instructions for Form 1040-NR (2024), Schedule NEC; Pub 519 Ch 4.

long_term_capital_gain_us_source_non_rea._note: Generally exempt unless NRA was present 183+ days during the tax year (IRC §871(a)(2)). If 183-day rule met, treated as effectively from US source at 30% on net gains.

treaty_override._note: Treaty-reduced rates (e.g., 0% for China Art 20(b) scholarships) override the statutory rate. Handled by TreatyEvaluator.
